primary: Unchanged bundled Kautzsch (1900), The Book of Maccabees I

bridge.use: Independent German passage and verse-reference comparison. Not displayed as an additional edition.

numberingAdjustment.reason: Both Menge final entries together form the single final Rahlfs verse, verified in Greek.

basis.review: German text-similarity candidates were reviewed by content; all split/merged candidates and low-similarity candidates were inspected. Overlapping sentence boundaries were conservatively joined. Greek chapter beginnings/endings and the divergent chapter-12 ending were also checked. This is passage correspondence, not word alignment.

notes.explanation: Der vorhandene Kautzsch-Text hat an Stelle 13:19 einen leeren Eintrag. Rahlfs 13:20 berichtet Tryphons Marsch über Adora und Simons Begleitung. Es wird kein deutscher Text ergänzt.
